page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-8-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 63.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core, positioning it as a high-density resource option for memory-intensive operations.

The instance is designed without integrated GPU hardware, making it inapplicable for accelerated graphics or hardware-dependent machine learning workloads. While the basic description indicates the presence of a local SSD, the primary storage configuration is designed to interface with external cloud storage volumes. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type.

Due to its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, this server is appropriate for workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute cores. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from neighboring virtual machines.
